sermon.title: God's Pleasure in the Death and Seed of Jesus 09/24/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches Isaiah 53:9–10: Jesus’ grave with the wicked and the rich, his innocence, and why it pleased God to bruise him—to see his seed. He discusses biblical hate as dislike, identifies the seed as the children of promise and the remnant who keep God’s commandments, presents Christ as the one seed, and traces church history from the former house through the falling away and restoration to the coming latter glory.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Roman empire divided 286 AD, Constantine 313 AD, fall 476 AD; Lutherans drowning Baptists; Calvin killing dissenters; nations discovered “till the late 1700s”. Sensitive content kept as spoken: seven-year tribulation “nonsense”; “God was up there doing a dance go on get him boy”; liberals/Democrats/socialists/homosexual activists/evolutionists/atheists redefining words and “united ... to destroy the morality of America”; okay to hate homosexuality and pass laws making it illegal; NFL kneeling, Trump and Obama; churches denied hurricane aid; atheist brother who hated Black people and Mexicans; Jews and Romans killed Jesus but “God killed him”, “blame God”; “the Jews aren’t the children of God”; serving the poor not mature Christianity; homosexuals started “tolerance” teaching in the seventies; Catholic church torture under Theodosius.
